name: a Class and three aggregates: one request at the frame's end; each wired output, then Success
because: aggregatenode.js :74-78 the Class asks; :286-310 the group (avgPts with no Operation is avg, names is distinct); ParseWireAdapter.ts :405-449 the old spelling; :160-167

name: nothing wired out of it: Success alone
because: :163-164 an output is flagged only when a wire made it

name: dbVersionMajor 5: $match / $group, and _id in place of objectId
because: ParseWireAdapter.ts :431-438

name: dbVersionMajor as the editor stores it, the text '5': the same spelling ('5' > 4)
because: schemahandler.ts :225-228 stores the major version as text; ParseWireAdapter.ts :431

name: a filter in the builder's saved shape with a static value: the request carries match=
because: :178-186; queryutils.ts :295-306

name: the retired visual shape and its parameter: the filter reads the parameter by its bare name
because: :357-360 qp-min is kept as min; saved.ts :271 a visual rule's input

name: the builder's saved shape with a CONNECTED value: the request carries the wired value in match= (P107-S99-AGGFILTERPREFIX, fixed in v2)
because: getStorageFilter passes valuePortPrefix 'qp-' (v2), so qp-min finds the parameter kept as min; before, the condition was dropped and the whole class aggregated

name: a filter parameter changes: the aggregation runs again
a filter that cannot be translated: Failure with the filter's own words, and no request
because: :145-152 setError(f.failed); :184-186

name: Do wired: a write asks for nothing; only Do does, once per frame however many presses
because: :77, :327, :332, :394 isInputConnected('storageFetch'); :362-371; :107-108; :394 a setting kept by name asks only when Do is not wired

name: Do unwired, pressed in a frame a write already asked in: still one request
because: :107 fetchScheduled

name: an aggregate named with no Property written: Failure naming it and no request; writing its Property asks for nothing, and the next Class write runs the aggregation (P107-S99-AGGNOPROP, R36, v2)
because: missingProperty (v2, R36 'Fail, naming it'); setAggregateParameter asks for nothing; a Class write asks and the aggregation runs. Before v2 the frame-end callback swallowed a throw and the node did nothing at all

name: Aggregates with an empty name (a stray comma): Failure saying so, no request; a Class write after the list is fixed runs it (v2)
because: missingProperty (v2): the empty name has no Property; before v2, the same swallowed throw

name: Aggregates written as something that is not text: nothing is asked or told that frame, and the next frame asks nothing until a write does
because: getAggregates: split on a list that is not text throws inside the frame-end callback, which swallows it; fetchScheduled was already cleared (:109-110), so a later Aggregates write asks nothing and the Class write after it runs the aggregation

name: a Property that is not a column of the class: that aggregate is left out of the request
an Operation the wire does not spell: that aggregate asks for {}
because: ParseWireAdapter.ts :421-428 only avg, sum, max, min, distinct

name: the built-in backend's cached columns: the aggregates are asked for, and each wired output carries its value (P107-S99-AGGCOLUMNS, fixed in v2)
because: classProperties reads columns as schemaFor does (v2); before, only schema.properties was read and no aggregate was asked for

name: a Class the project does not have: no aggregate is asked for
a second Success with a new total: the output moves
because: :161 aggregateValues replaced

name: an answer with no row after one with values: Success, and every wired output goes empty (null) (P107-S99-AGGSTALE, R36, v2)
because: ParseWireAdapter.ts aggregate hands {} for a row count other than 1; the node now gives every aggregate asked null and sends each wired output (v2, R36 'Empty, like our backend')

name: an answer with two rows: Success, and every wired output goes empty (null)
because: ParseWireAdapter.ts :454-457; v2 (R36): every aggregate asked is null when the answer carried none

name: a 201 with one row: the same as a 200
because: ParseWireAdapter.ts :341

name: a 400 that names its cause: Failure, with the server's words on Error (P107-S99-AGGWORDS, fixed in v2)
because: ParseWireAdapter.ts aggregate's error(res) passes res && res.error on, as query does since HLT-023

name: a 500 with an HTML body: Failure
because: ParseWireAdapter.ts :350-354

name: a 200 whose body is not JSON: Failure
because: ParseWireAdapter.ts :343-346

name: a 200 whose body is JSON null: Failure
because: ParseWireAdapter.ts :454 null.results throws in the chain; :345 its catch

name: a [null] row with aggregates asked: Failure
because: ParseWireAdapter.ts :459-461 reads the row once per aggregate

name: a [null] row with none asked: Success
because: ParseWireAdapter.ts :459-461 an empty group never reads the row

name: the request never reaches the server: Failure, with the fault's message
because: ParseWireAdapter.ts _makeRequest's .catch hands { error: e.message }; aggregate passes it on (v2)

name: a Failure, then a Success: Error keeps the failure's sentence
because: :97-103 only setError writes Error

name: no loopback and no project endpoint: Failure inside the frame with the no-backend sentence, no request
because: ParseWireAdapter.ts _makeRequest (P107-C33's refusal) hands NO_BACKEND_CONFIGURED; aggregate passes it on (v2)

name: no loopback: the project's own endpoint and app id, and no master key
because: ParseWireAdapter.ts :302-306; cloudstore.js :120-126

name: the run's id on the loopback: X-NodeGX-Run
because: ParseWireAdapter.ts :324-331 (P99 HLT-023)

name: a slow answer and a second aggregation before it lands: each answer is told in turn
because: each request is its own fetch chain

name: no Class: nothing asks for an aggregation until a Class is written
a setting kept by name: an aggregation
because: :383-395 userInputSetter

name: an empty Aggregates list: no aggregate asked
because: :287 !aggregatesList
